name: confirm-gate
description: Pauses risky shell commands and edits that match your patterns and asks you to proceed or cancel with buttons.

bash_patterns.title: Bash command patterns
bash_patterns.description: Case-insensitive JavaScript regular expressions tested against each Bash command. One match pauses the call.

path_patterns.title: Edited path patterns
path_patterns.description: Case-insensitive JavaScript regular expressions tested against the file path of Edit, Write and MultiEdit calls (backslashes normalized to slashes). Empty: paths are not checked.
